J&K Statehood Protest Planned Amidst Calls for Restoration

The National Conference (NC) has announced a protest at Jantar Mantar on July 20, demanding the restoration of statehood for Jammu and Kashmir. Civil society members and NC leaders have urged the Centre to expedite this process, criticizing the delay. The BJP has dismissed the protest as an 'eyewash'.
